caption:
#EpicPartner Todo sobre la Tienda Pirata de Fortnite 🏴‍☠️ Cómo se consigue, qué te da, las probabilidades oficiales, las Horas del Tesoro (hora CDMX), qué no incluye y los mitos.
Usa el código BAD en la tienda de objetos 💛
#Fortnite #TiendaPirata #FortniteEspañol

claims.text: La mini temporada va del 1 de noviembre al 5 de diciembre
match: started on November 1 and is set to end on December 5

claims.text: Búsqueda del tesoro en Battle Royale y Cero construcción; abrir o romper cofres da una pequeña probabilidad
match: open chests during Battle Royale and Zero Build modes
every time you open or break a chest, there's a small chance that you'll get a treasure reward

claims.text: Cualquier tipo de cofre: normales, raros, enterrados y otros
match: This can be any type of chest, including: Normal chests, Rare chests, Sprite Chests, Buried Chests, Wanted Poster Chests, Relic Chests

claims.text: El premio no se recoge; aparece un mensaje en pantalla
match: you won't have to pick it up – you'll just get a message on the screen telling you what you got

claims.text: Tres niveles: estándar (objetos de partida), mayor (cosméticos de la semana), supremo (skin dorada o Tienda Pirata)
match: Treasure Hunt prizes are split into three tiers – Standard, Major and Supreme
If it's Major you'll get one of the current week's special cosmetics
if it's Supreme, you'll get one of two things – that week's gold skin or the Pirate Shop Token

claims.text: 14 días: todo lo que cuesta pavos es gratis; skins, gestos, mochilas, picos, instrumentos, autos, planeadores
match: every single item in the Fortnite Shop which costs V-Bucks – skins, emotes, backpacks, pickaxes, instruments, cars, gliders, jam tracks and more – becomes entirely free to that player for the next 14 days
you keep the items forever

claims.text: Dos fichas: 1 nov-15 dic 2026 y todo 2027
match: one which can be activated at any point in 2026 between November 1 and December 15, and one which can be activated at any point in 2027 between January 1 and December 31
Pirate Shop Access – 1 in 137,500
Weekly Gold Outfit – 1 in 1,562,500
Weekly Vehicle & Decal – 1 in 7,813
Weekly Pickaxe or Backbling – 1 in 568
Weekly Loading Screen – 1 in 272

claims.text: Menos del 0.001 % por cofre; las probabilidades no han cambiado desde el inicio
match: That works out to about 0.00073% per chest
the normal chest drop rates have stayed the same since Fortnite Treasure Hunters launched

claims.text: Horas del Tesoro: sábados 14, 21, 28 nov y 5 dic; 11 AM-1 PM y 6-8 PM PT (1-3 PM y 8-10 PM CDMX); ×1.5 ≈ 1 en 91 667
match: run on Saturdays during the Treasure Hunters mini-season
November 14 | 11 AM–1 PM PT / 2–4 PM ET | 6–8 PM PT / 9–11 PM ET | 1.5× both rounds
November 21 | 11 AM–1 PM PT
November 28 | 11 AM–1 PM PT
December 5 | 11 AM–1 PM PT
A 1.5× boost brings it to about 1 in 91,667

claims.text: Escuadrón: cuentan los cofres de los cuatro; rellenar escuadrón
match: in each round you're opening four times as many chests as usual
choose the Fill option to add random players to your squad of four

claims.text: Si alguien del escuadrón la encuentra, todos la reciben
match: all squad members will get it too

claims.text: No incluye niveles del pase, lotes de dinero real ni regalos; solo un sidekick
match: you can't claim Battle Pass levels
you can't get bundles that cost real money
you can't gift items to other players
you can only claim one free sidekick

claims.text: Mitos: brújula, skin, jugadores nuevos, cofres con mejores probabilidades: todo falso
match: There's no such thing as a Token Compass
the skin you choose has no effect on your odds
some chests give better odds than others
These are all nonsense
everyone has an equal chance of finding a Pirate Shop Token

claims.text: La probabilidad no cambia según el jugador, nuevo o que regresa
match: the rate does not change depending on the player, so the likelihood doesn't improve if you're a new or returning player
